pages.title: Pampas Deer
pages.text: The pampas deer ($(o)Ozotoceros bezoarticus$()) is a small, slender deer that lives in the open grasslands of South America, from Brazil to Argentina.$(br2)Males have glands in their hind hooves that give off a strong, distinctive odour that can be detected from a considerable distance.$(br2)Once abundant across the pampas, it has declined greatly as its grasslands were converted to farmland and pasture.
